usefulness.rationale: The dossier clearly establishes who Anders Danielsson is: President & CEO of Skanska AB (since 2018, corroborated by multiple 2020–2026 sources), with a well-documented career path (design manager on the Electrolux HQ, President of Skanska Norway and Sweden, President & CEO of Skanska USA, then group CEO), his KTH degree, and a rich set of his public statements and strategic positions (selective strategy, 3,000-person workforce reduction, views on the U.S. market, data centers, tariffs, property market weakness). A reader comes away knowing who he is and what he has done and said. It falls short of 3 because the dossier simultaneously presents his past Skanska USA role in the present tense alongside his current Skanska AB role, creating an unresolved contradiction about what his current position actually is. On remaining questions, the dossier does not articulate what it does not know — there is no statement of gaps (e.g., no birth date, board mandates, or personal details are flagged as missing); only metadata 'contested' flags hint at uncertainty, so it partially implies completeness. Conversation readiness is solid: a reader would know his title, career history, and his most recent on-the-record views (stable U.S. operations, data center positioning, weak commercial development outlook, order backlog and Q4 figures), which is enough to prepare talking points, but the stale USA-CEO framing risks a factual error in a live meeting, keeping it below 3.
